implementation.scope: Endpoint node, queue backing and observer lists prepare fallibly outside IPC; queue growth retains both backings through checked FIFO replacement and post-guard disposal; final closed endpoint nodes retire through existing cleanup owners.
implementation.preparation: Capture namespace under IPC, release before acquiring exact-root operation, revalidate before atomic record/slot reservation. Complete inert owner retains original account/class, split charges, node, queue, close/readiness lists and authority. Unused prefix explicitly finishes after local guards, root last; fallback retains every field.
implementation.publication: Endpoint AdmittedMap only relinks prepared nodes. Shared authority is published by borrowing the retained reservation. Unified authority factory entry and per-capability BTreeMap insertion still occur under IPC; latter remains infallible after authority mutation.
implementation.growth: Retains exact root/endpoint and original account/class before unlocked slot admission/backing allocation. Rechecks namespace, cap, endpoint, closing state and backing capacity before FIFO move. Competing larger growth cancels unused preparation; close rejects. Replaced backing stays in same owner until post-IPC explicit free/refund, root last.
implementation.retirement: Final references to closed empty unclaimed endpoints detach complete nodes into existing cancellation, endpoint-close or serialized cleanup owners. Nodes retain original record counts through actual payload/node free outside IPC; fallback retains whole temporary list. Failed loans stay fenced. No new registry or physical recovery interface.
implementation.classification: Published endpoint retains its original budget Arc and actual reservation class for growth and claim-source preparation. Promotion and ASID reuse do not redirect original charges or late refunds.

abandonment.private_unpublished_creation: One exact root/lease, one node/count and four slots, plus complete empty observer lists.
abandonment.growth: One exact root/lease; live endpoint with four old slots plus eight private new slots.
abandonment.detached_node: One complete private closed endpoint node/count with empty queue backed by four slots, retained through confirmed root retirement and exact slot reuse.

controls.injection_qualification: Explicit stage rejection before/after real admitted allocations, not exhaustion of the global allocator.

shared authority factory preparation under outer IPC guard
other waiter/vector/control-block factories, weak retention and payload destructors
